claim.claim-text: wherein said surgical end effector comprises a firing member that is configured for axial travel within said surgical end effector and wherein said elongate shaft assembly further comprises an axially movable firing beam operably interfacing with said firing member and being selectively movable in said distal direction in response to a firing motion applied thereto, said firing beam being selectively movable in said proximal direction in response to a retraction motion applied thereto.

2. The surgical instrument of Claim 1, wherein said articulation driver is configured to apply a first articulation motion to said surgical end effector only in one articulation direction that is transverse to said shaft axis.

3. The surgical instrument of Claim 1 or 2, wherein said surgical end effector defines an end effector axis and wherein said end effector is movable between an unarticulated position wherein said effector axis is axially aligned with said shaft axis to a maximum articulated position on one lateral side of said shaft axis wherein said end effector axis is perpendicular to said shaft axis.

4. The surgical instrument of any of Claims 1 to 3, wherein said articulation driver and said end effector driver link are located on one lateral side of said shaft axis when said surgical end effector is in an unarticulated orientation.

5. The surgical instrument of any of Claims 1 to 4, wherein said proximal end of said surgical end effector is pivotally pinned to said distal end of said elongate shaft assembly by an articulation pin and wherein said flexible de-articulation member is configured to flex around said articulation pin when said surgical end effector is articulated about said articulation axis.

6. The surgical instrument of any of Claims 1 to 5, wherein said proximal end of said surgical end effector is angled relative to said end effector axis and wherein said distal end of said elongate shaft assembly is angled relative to said shaft axis.

7. The surgical instrument of Claim 6, wherein said proximal end of said surgical end effector is oriented at an end effector angle relative to said end effector axis and wherein said distal end of said elongate shaft assembly is oriented at a shaft angle relative to said shaft axis.
8. The surgical end effector of Claim 7, wherein said end effector angle and said shaft angle are equal to each other.
